page.layout: One page of text: a title at the top, centred, followed by a printed list of contents in full lines, each entry with its folio or page number at the right. No margins, no running head. Catchword "Ein" at the bottom right.

main_text.head: dises Büchleins.
main_text.l: vom Herrn Pirckheymer inns Teutsch ge-
Auß dem heiligen Johann. Samasceno ein
mit welchen die Menschen bekrieget wer-
Sie fünff Tugenden / so Gott inn die Menschheit geußt / und davon die ander Tugenden
Ein heylsame Ermanung deß Kindleins Jesu
an den Sünder/gezogen auß Erasmo / La-
Baum der siben Todsünde/ mit seinen zweygen
Athen/ Sittliche Ermanung an den Jüng-
ein junger Gesell unnd jeder privatus sein
leben wol und löblich anstellen/ vñ sich dar-

page.notes: The word "Martyrers Nili" is uncertain: the letter after "Martyrers" could be N or V, so I have read it as Nili. The "2c." is copied as printed. The mark ")" at the top right is a printer's or stray mark and is left out. The page numbers at the right of entries are copied as printed, including the Arabic 1 in "fol.41" and the 5 in "45", which appear in an old form. "solle" in the last entry is read from a long-s form and may be "folle" in the print. The "ꝯ" and other abbreviations do not occur on this page.
